credits.title: Malamar Gawian
credits.overview: Highlights the challenge of finding a job after completing higher education. Amid the competition in the job market, college graduates must also face pressure from their families and communities, who expect them to find work immediately.

credits.title: Jangan Dicium
credits.overview: After a long-term relationship, Jali risks losing his chance to marry Ainun—all because his body odor is potent enough to knock out his prospective in-laws. Now, Jali is in a race against time to find a way to smell fresh before Ainun is married off to someone else. Can Jali save his romance, or will his body odor end

credits.title: Pirunduk
credits.overview: A wronged wife in a remote village on the Tanah Banjar river, South Kalimantan. When she becomes a wandering spirit, she seeks revenge on those who have hurt her and collects debts that have not been paid off during her lifetime.

credits.title: Kuyank
credits.overview: Seven years prior to the breach of the mystical Saranjana portal, a remote stilt village built upon the treacherous swamps of interior Kalimantan becomes the epicenter of a terrifying theological crisis as the grotesque mechanics of an ancient black magic curse—the Kuyang—are violently unearthed.

credits.title: Badrun & Laundry
credits.overview: A civil servant taking shelter from the rain in front of a laundry shop. Then, he was given a bag of laundry clothes which he thought belonged to the laundry shop clerk. Unexpectedly, he took the bag containing lots of clothes and ran away and sparked a commotion in the surrounding community.

credits.title: Saranjana: Supernatural City
credits.overview: A band’s vocalist, Sitha, mysteriously disappears before their concert in Kotabaru, South Kalimantan. The band learns she's in Saranjana, a supernatural city believed to be advanced and hidden. To bring her back, they must journey through horror and mystical events to find the portal to Saranjana.

credits.title: Dorasembada
credits.overview: Ahmad (48), a head of a household who has just been laid off by a coal mining company, wants to keep his house that the coal mining company wants to buy, but the condition of his daughter, who suffers from chronic bronchitis, makes Ahmad need money to cure his daughter.
